<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="800" viewBox="0 0 1200 800">
  <title>Sleepy Sloth on the Excavator</title>
  <desc>A cartoon sloth in a hard hat and high-vis vest operating a yellow tracked excavator on a sunny construction site. Fully self-contained SVG with SMIL animation, no external assets.</desc>

  <defs>
    <!-- Sky gradient: warm sunny day -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8ccbf0"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#cfe8fc"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffe6b3"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Sun glow -->
    <radialGradient id="sunGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff5a0"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ffcc33"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffcc33" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Ground -->
    <linearGradient id="groundGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7c4a16"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5a320e"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Dirt pile -->
    <linearGradient id="dirtGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c78a52"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8d5a2f"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Excavator yellow -->
    <linearGradient id="excaYellow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffd94d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e8b400"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Metal -->
    <linearGradient id="metalGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#98a3af"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ced7e0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#98a3af"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Sloth brown -->
    <linearGradient id="slothGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b59373"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8f6d50"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- High-vis vest -->
    <linearGradient id="vestGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#bdf45a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#82d624"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Cloud -->
    <radialGradient id="cloudGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e9f0f6"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Soft shadow -->
    <filter id="dropShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2.5"/>
      <feOffset dx="2" dy="3" result="offsetblur"/>
      <feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.4"/></feComponentTransfer>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>

    <!-- Track conveyor clip region -->
    <clipPath id="trackClip">
      <rect x="420" y="516" width="450" height="50"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <!-- ========== SKY ========== -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#skyGradient)"/>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <g transform="translate(1030, 95)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="64" fill="url(#sunGlow)"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="40" fill="#ffd24d" stroke="#f4a400" stroke-width="3"/>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="20s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <line x1="44" y1="0" x2="60" y2="0" stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="44" y1="0" x2="60" y2="0" stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(45)"/>
      <line x1="44" y1="0" x2="60" y2="0" stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(90)"/>
      <line x1="44" y1="0" x2="60" y2="0" stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(135)"/>
      <line x1="44" y1="0" x2="60" y2="0" stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(180)"/>
      <line x1="44" y1="0" x2="60" y2="0" stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(225)"/>
      <line x1="44" y1="0" x2="60" y2="0" stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(270)"/>
      <line x1="44" y1="0" x2="60" y2="0" stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(315)"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Clouds drifting -->
  <g transform="translate(-180, 110)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;1380 0" dur="24s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="48" ry="24" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
      <ellipse cx="38" cy="-6" rx="56" ry="20" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
      <ellipse cx="86" cy="4" rx="46" ry="22" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
      <ellipse cx="122" cy="-8" rx="42" ry="18" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(-300, 200)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;1500 0" dur="30s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="2s"/>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="40" ry="20" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
      <ellipse cx="32" cy="-4" rx="48" ry="18" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
      <ellipse cx="72" cy="2" rx="40" ry="20" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
      <ellipse cx="104" cy="-6" rx="36" ry="16" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(-120, 270)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;1400 0" dur="22s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="5s"/>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="44" ry="22" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
      <ellipse cx="36" cy="-5" rx="50" ry="19" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
      <ellipse cx="80" cy="3" rx="44" ry="21" fill="url(#cloudGrad)"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bird crossing the sky -->
  <g transform="translate(-140, 158)">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;1320 0" dur="10s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g transform="translate(0, 0)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="5" ry="2.4" fill="#546878"/>
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="scale" values="1 1;1 0.3;1 1" dur="0.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <path d="M-9,-3 Q0,-10 9,-3 M-9,3 Q0,10 9,3" fill="none" stroke="#546878" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ========== GROUND ========== -->
  <rect x="0" y="568" width="1200" height="232" fill="url(#groundGradient)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="568" width="1200" height="8" fill="#64340d"/>

  <!-- Distant hill (left) -->
  <path d="M 0 568 Q 160 544 340 566 L 420 568 L 420 800 L 0 800 Z" fill="#6e4316"/>

  <!-- Construction rocks (left) -->
  <circle cx="118" cy="560" r="9" fill="#99a0a6" stroke="#70767c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="308" cy="556" r="10" fill="#99a0a6" stroke="#70767c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="354" cy="562" r="8" fill="#99a0a6" stroke="#70767c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="394" cy="554" r="11" fill="#99a0a6" stroke="#70767c" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Traffic cones (left) -->
  <g transform="translate(188, 552)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="28" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#e55a10"/>
    <polygon points="-12,28 0,-16 12,28" fill="#f26a1e" stroke="#c04a10" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="-9" cy="0" x="-9" y="4" width="18" height="6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(234, 546)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="28" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#e55a10"/>
    <polygon points="-12,28 0,-16 12,28" fill="#f26a1e" stroke="#c04a10" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="-9" y="4" width="18" height="6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Caution-stripe barrier (left) -->
  <rect x="299" y="500" width="5" height="72" fill="#6b5544"/>
  <rect x="396" y="500" width="5" height="72" fill="#6b5544"/>
  <rect x="304" y="500" width="92" height="18" fill="#ffd600"/>
  <rect x="312" y="500" width="12" height="18" fill="#222222"/>
  <rect x="336" y="500" width="12" height="18" fill="#222222"/>
  <rect x="360" y="500" width="12" height="18" fill="#222222"/>
  <rect x="384" y="500" width="12" height="18" fill="#222222"/>

  <!-- ========== DIRT PILE ========== -->
  <g transform="translate(0, 0)">
    <path d="M 800 568 L 838 552 Q 880 536 928 500 Q 976 532 1020 556 L 1080 568 Z" fill="url(#dirtGradient)" stroke="#7d4a22" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="870" cy="542" r="7" fill="#a87442" opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="930" cy="516" r="6" fill="#a87442" opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="990" cy="548" r="7" fill="#a87442" opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="1040" cy="560" r="5" fill="#a87442" opacity="0.85"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Construction rocks (right) -->
  <circle cx="1116" cy="562" r="10" fill="#99a0a6" stroke="#70767c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="1156" cy="556" r="12" fill="#99a0a6" stroke="#70767c" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Traffic cones (right) -->
  <g transform="translate(1040, 558)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="28" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#e55a10"/>
    <polygon points="-12,28 0,-16 12,28" fill="#f26a1e" stroke="#c04a10" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="-9" y="4" width="18" height="6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(1090, 554)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="28" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#e55a10"/>
    <polygon points="-12,28 0,-16 12,28" fill="#f26a1e" stroke="#c04a10" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="-9" y="4" width="18" height="6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Grass tufts (right) -->
  <g stroke="#74a02a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <path d="M 1100 572 Q 1104 588 1108 574"/>
    <path d="M 1130 570 Q 1134 586 1138 572"/>
    <path d="M 1162 574 Q 1166 590 1170 576"/>
    <path d="M 1188 571 Q 1192 587 1196 573"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ========== EXCAVATOR TRACKS ========== -->
  <!-- Track belts -->
  <rect x="420" y="516" width="450" height="50" rx="6" fill="#232323"/>
  <rect x="420" y="516" width="450" height="6" fill="#3b3b3b"/>

  <!-- Conveyor-style moving track links -->
  <g clip-path="url(#trackClip)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;460 0" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <rect x="25" y="4" width="22" height="42" rx="3" fill="#444444" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="150" y="4" width="22" height="42" rx="3" fill="#444444" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="275" y="4" width="22" height="42" rx="3" fill="#444444" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="400" y="4" width="22" height="42" rx="3" fill="#444444" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="1"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Rollers / wheels -->
  <g transform="translate(432, 540)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="11" fill="#8a8a8a" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="4" fill="#5c5c5c"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(862, 540)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="13" fill="#7e7e7e" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="5" fill="#5c5c5c"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(468, 570)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="#848484" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(550, 570)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="#848484" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(632, 570)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="#848484" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(714, 570)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="#848484" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(796, 570)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="#848484" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <!-- Top rollers -->
  <g transform="translate(500, 522)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#6e6e6e" stroke="#444" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(592, 522)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#6e6e6e" stroke="#444" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(720, 522)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#6e6e6e" stroke="#444" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(802, 522)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#6e6e6e" stroke="#444" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ========== EXCAVATOR BODY / CAB ========== -->
  <!-- Rotating platform -->
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="504" rx="104" ry="34" fill="#5a4e40" stroke="#453a2e" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Hydraulic detail -->
  <rect x="718" y="486" width="7" height="26" rx="2" fill="#90a8b0" stroke="#6b808a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- House -->
  <g transform="translate(552, 412)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="176" height="104" rx="14" fill="url(#excaYellow)" stroke="#b58a00" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="8" y="2" width="160" height="18" rx="6" fill="#e8b200"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Cab window (dark interior) -->
  <g transform="translate(578, 432)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="124" height="64" rx="10" fill="#17304a" stroke="#0e2236" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x="762" y="426" width="9" height="20" rx="2" fill="#707070" stroke="#4a4a4a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- ========== SLOTH ========== -->
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="482" rx="40" ry="28" fill="url(#slothGrad)" stroke="#7a5e44" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- High-vis vest -->
  <g transform="translate(612, 458)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="56" height="40" rx="9" fill="url(#vestGrad)" stroke="#7fb01a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <rect x="6" y="14" width="34" height="3" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.92"/>
    <rect x="6" y="30" width="34" height="3" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.92"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="645" cy="448" r="28" fill="url(#slothGrad)" stroke="#7a5e44" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="620" cy="442" rx="6" ry="9" fill="url(#slothGrad)" stroke="#7a5e44" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="670" cy="442" rx="6" ry="9" fill="url(#slothGrad)" stroke="#7a5e44" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Face mask -->
  <ellipse cx="645" cy="452" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#ecd7a8"/>
  <!-- Eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx="629" cy="448" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#34261e"/>
  <ellipse cx="661" cy="448" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#34261e"/>
  <!-- Eyes (half-closed, blinking) -->
  <ellipse cx="629" cy="448" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#1e1610">
    <animate attributeName="ry" values="3;0.3;3" keyTimes="0;0.18;0.26" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </ellipse>
  <ellipse cx="661" cy="448" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#1e1610">
    <animate attributeName="ry" values="3;0.3;3" keyTimes="0;0.18;0.26" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </ellipse>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="645" cy="461" rx="2.5" rx="2.5" ry="1.6" fill="#34261e"/>
  <!-- Sleepy smile -->
  <path d="M 633 467 Q 645 470 657 467" fill="none" stroke="#7a4e36" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Hard hat -->
  <ellipse cx="645" cy="434" rx="24" ry="14" fill="#f4d03f" stroke="#d4a017" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <rect x="615" y="442" width="60" height="8" rx="2" fill="#e6b800"/>
  <rect x="619" y="430" width="52" height="6" rx="1" fill="#34261e" fill-opacity="0.85"/>

  <!-- Steering wheel -->
  <g transform="translate(598, 468)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-12;16;-12" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="14" fill="#4a3728" stroke="#8d6e63" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line x1="-14" y1="0" x2="14" y2="0" stroke="#a18875" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="-14" x2="0" y2="14" stroke="#a18875" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="4" fill="#5d4037"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Sloth's arm reaching to the steering wheel, with claws -->
  <path d="M 608 486 L 600 478 L 594 470" fill="none" stroke="#a08268" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="594" cy="470" r="5.5" fill="url(#slothGrad)" stroke="#7a5e44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 594 470 L 586 474 M 594 470 L 584 469 M 594 470 L 586 464" fill="none" stroke="#6f5a48" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- ========== EXCAVATOR ARM (boom + stick + bucket) ========== -->
  <!-- Boom pivot -->
  <g transform="translate(738, 506)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
        values="12;-38;-38;12;12" keyTimes="0;0.3;0.5;0.8;1" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <!-- Boom -->
      <rect x="8" y="-16" width="160" height="32" rx="9" fill="url(#excaYellow)" stroke="#b58a00" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <rect x="14" y="-10" width="140" height="6" fill="#ffe082" opacity="0.9"/>

      <!-- Stick pivot (boom tip) -->
      <g transform="translate(160, 0)">
        <g>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
            values="7;7;55;55;7" keyTimes="0;0.3;0.5;0.8;1" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <!-- Stick -->
          <rect x="6" y="-14" width="128" height="28" rx="8" fill="url(#excaYellow)" stroke="#b58a00" stroke-width="2.5"/>
          <rect x="10" y="-8" width="112" height="4" fill="#ffe082" opacity="0.9"/>

          <!-- Bucket pivot (stick tip) -->
          <g transform="translate(128, 0)">
            <g>
              <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
                values="0;0;20;20;0" keyTimes="0;0.3;0.5;0.8;1" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <!-- Bucket -->
              <path d="M 0 -6 L 36 -6 L 38 10 L 0 10 Z" fill="#8d99a6" stroke="#5b6570" stroke-width="2"/>
              <!-- Bucket teeth -->
              <path d="M 2 10 L 6 16 L 10 10 M 14 10 L 18 16 L 22 10 M 26 10 L 30 16 L 34 10"
                    fill="none" stroke="#a8b0b8" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            </g>
          </g>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ========== EXHAUST PUFFS ========== -->
  <g transform="translate(766, 424)">
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="13" ry="8" fill="#d9d9d9" filter="url(#blurSoft)">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.7;0" keyTimes="0;0.3;1" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0s"/>
        <animate attributeName="rx" values="13;16" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0s"/>
        <animate attributeName="ry" values="8;10" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0s"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;0 -26" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0s"/>
      </ellipse>
    </g>
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="13" ry="8" fill="#d9d9d9" filter="url(#blurSoft)">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.7;0" keyTimes="0;0.3;1" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="1.7s"/>
        <animate attributeName="rx" values="13;16" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="1.7s"/>
        <animate attributeName="ry" values="8;10" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="1.7s"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;0 -26" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="1.7s"/>
      </ellipse>
    </g>
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="13" ry="8" fill="#d9d9d9" filter="url(#blurSoft)">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.7;0" keyTimes="0;0.3;1" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="3.4s"/>
        <animate attributeName="rx" values="13;16" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="3.4s"/>
        <animate attributeName="ry" values="8;10" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="3.4s"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;0 -26" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="3.4s"/>
      </ellipse>
    </g>
  </g>
